sources.title: LibreYOLO/LibreRTDETRv2x-obb · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LibreRTDETRv2x-obb RT-DETRv2-X oriented-object detector trained on DOTA 1.0 and converted for LibreYOLO. Source The architecture is derived from RicePasteM/RiO-DETR at commit 22d5232a4e0df6ac4bc26ed1c8aac8b4060449c7. The official checkpoint comes from RicePasteM/RT-DETR-OBB at revision f376e9dcedfb9a47a21ac71ef61ad99f8b545698.
